rotation: Same three sessions fixed to Mon / Wed / Fri so load progression stays readable week to week.
note: Week of 09-21 went 0 of 3. Nothing has been logged since 09-16, which is eleven days. Cutting Monday to three lifts last week did not get Monday logged, so this week cuts harder across the board: nine working exercises total, down from twelve. Monday is two lifts and opens with the favorited lat pulldown, because the only job Monday has is to exist. Triceps pushdown and reverse pec deck moved off Wednesday and Friday into add-in S, which keeps the volume available without putting it on the critical path. Any session can be opened on any day from the week view, so a Monday that slips to Tuesday still counts as done. Straight sets, no supersets.

progression.rule: Double progression driven by the average RPE of the logged sets, matching the suggester already running in workout.html.
table: avg RPE 7.0 or below: add one load_step from assets/exercises.js.
avg RPE 7.1 to 8.0: hold the load and add a rep, unless every set was already at the same load and at the top of the prescribed rep range, which earns the load step instead.
avg RPE 8.1 to 9.0: repeat the same load and clean up execution.
avg RPE above 9.0: hold, or back off five percent.
Bodyweight and timed work progresses on reps or seconds, never load.
Dumbbell loads are per hand, so one load_step of 5 is one size up on one bell.
Any of the above is overridden when the session note reports pain or a form breakdown. Load does not advance on a pattern he cannot yet brace.
progression.note: Nothing was logged the week of 09-21, so every load below is carried forward unchanged from last week's program rather than advanced. Prescriptions are still keyed to the last session each exercise actually appeared in: 09-16 for the Wednesday lifts, 09-11 for the Friday lifts, 09-09 for the lat pulldown. workout.html does not know the rep-range ceiling, so its on-page suggestion can read 'chase a rep' where the program names a heavier load. The program's named load wins. LOGGING-SPEC.md still has no progression section; this field is the working record until it does.

sessions.title: Pull & Legs
sessions.focus: One vertical pull and one knee-dominant leg press. Two lifts, about fifteen minutes. This is a floor, not a target, and it is deliberately short enough that there is nothing left to negotiate with.

exercises.name: Lat pulldown
exercises.cue: Your favorite lift goes first so the session opens with something you want to do. Standard wide bar, not the rotating-handle machine. 100 for 10 across on 09-09, so hold 100 and chase 12 before the load moves.

exercises.name: Leg press
exercises.cue: Still no history on this one. Pick a load you can finish ten clean reps with and write the number down. Stop before your hips curl off the pad.

sessions.title: Hinge, Press & Brace
sessions.focus: Loaded hip extension, vertical pressing, horizontal pulling, and the anti-lordosis brace. Wednesday is the day with the best history, so it still carries the most work.

exercises.name: Hip thrust
exercises.cue: Programmed last week and never run. Stop at a straight line from knee to shoulder, ribs down. Record the load so this slot finally has a history.

exercises.name: Overhead dumbbell press
exercises.cue: 30 per hand, same as 09-16, where the third set dropped to 25 at RPE 9. Three clean sets at 30 is the whole job. Per hand, not the pair.

exercises.name: Seated cable row
exercises.cue: Never logged yet. Torso stays still, pull with the back, and record the load.

exercises.name: Bird dog
exercises.cue: Easier to hold a flat back than the dead bug, which fell apart by set three on 09-16. Hips square, slow beats far.

sessions.title: Single-leg & Chest
sessions.focus: One leg at a time for hip stability, incline pressing, and a single-arm row. Three lifts, about twenty minutes.

exercises.name: Walking lunge
exercises.cue: 30 per hand on all three sets. On 09-11 set one was 20, so the load step still has not been earned. Per hand.

exercises.name: Incline dumbbell press
exercises.cue: 30 per hand for 10 across at Hard on 09-11 earned the step and it is still owed. Go to 35 per hand, bench at 30 degrees.

exercises.name: Single-arm cable row
exercises.cue: One arm at a time, single handle. You ran it two-handed on 09-11 and the load went unrecorded. Let the shoulder blade travel forward, then pull, and write the number down.

optional_addins.title: Hips & Posture
optional_addins.focus: Direct work on the lordosis: lengthen the hip flexors, get the glutes doing their job, brace without arching. The dead bug lost its brace on 09-16, and this is why.
optional_addins.when: Any off day. 10 minutes. The one that actually moves the lordosis.

exercises.name: Couch stretch
exercises.cue: Squeeze the back glute to tuck the pelvis. That tuck is the stretch.

exercises.name: Glute bridge
exercises.cue: Stop at a straight line. Do not arch past it.

exercises.name: Dead bug
exercises.cue: If the low back lifts, keep your heels sliding on the floor instead of hovering. Range is negotiable, the flat back is not.

optional_addins.title: Arms, Shoulders & Calves
optional_addins.focus: Low-stakes volume for arms, delts and calves. Nothing here taxes recovery, so skip it guilt-free. This is where the triceps pushdown and reverse pec deck live now, off the critical path.
optional_addins.when: Saturday flex day, or bolted onto the end of any session that felt short. 20 minutes.

exercises.name: Cable lateral raise
exercises.cue: Lead with the elbow, stop at shoulder height.

exercises.name: Dumbbell curl
exercises.cue: Elbows at your sides. No swinging from the hips.

exercises.name: Triceps pushdown
exercises.cue: Parked at 35 for two sessions running. Stay at 35 and get 12 on all three sets, then it moves to 40.

exercises.name: Reverse pec deck
exercises.cue: The rear-delt slot. Elbows soft, light enough that nothing leans back.

exercises.name: Standing calf raise
exercises.cue: Full stretch at the bottom, pause at the top, and record the load.
